title: Review of c06's pmic frozen micelles: on fresh seed 5, F=0.01 packs into a hexagonal crystal and F=0.005 saturates at 66 micelles with no turnover
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged (F=0.01) and with F=0.005 (world_F005.py only sets F) on fresh seed 5, T=1000, labkit. F=0.01: micelles form from noise by t~40, divide (41 persistent splits, generation 4) and pack into a hexagonal crystal of ~110 touching bodies by t~600 that does not change to t=1000 (labkit counts 83 at the end because touching bodies merge at its threshold; merge/split 0.58). F=0.005: 66 micelles by t~300, then exactly 66 at every frame to t=1000, 20 persistent splits (generation 3) early, merge/split 0.07, persistent bodies at nearly constant size (area ratio 1.34). The finding replicates.

observations.D: rerun_F0.01/seed5/sheet.png t=480-1000: frozen hexagonal crystal; rerun_F0.005/seed5 metrics n_comp 66 at every 20th frame from t~300 to 1000, 20 persistent splits early

controls_run.D: feed scan: rerun_F0.01/ and rerun_F0.005/ on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: I did not count deaths directly (labkit has no death ledger); a constant count of 66 with no merges at F=0.005 is consistent with none. The heritable-yield arms (cy 0.1, 0.3) and F=0.003 were not re-run. T=1000 only; longer runs could still show turnover.
